description: Implementation of CustomerService interface providing customer-related operations such as retrieval, update, and deletion within a sales management system.

classes.name: CustomerServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing customer-related business logic, extending generic entity service, and annotated as a Spring Service.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching the given first name.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by their unique ID.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by their nickname.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by nickname within a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers by store with specific criteria.

methods.name: getCustomerAddress
methods.description: Gets customer address based on IP address, using GeoLocation service.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a customer record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a customer and associated attributes.
